items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I got to play Oklahoma and I got to meet the great Charlie Christie.

ctx.x: You didn't know your uncle's name that played music on there, that your mother played

the name? Where he's from? Oh well, my mother was born and growing up with Virginia. You understand? They came here from Virginia. She was a, what you call a practical nurse and they come down here. Well, it was a lady who used to live on 2nd Street, or Phillips City Street, I believe it was, Miss Cecilia Logan. She used to be the head training nurse at Hotel Duke. Well, she got my mother's job nursing, Chief O'Connor. Chief O'Connor was the chief of police at that time, you understand? And got her nursing around…
Who were playing with you then?
